expectations.note: The candidate event trail records dragByKey with shotStep=10 and the resulting seek_during.png capture; inspecting that artifact showed the bottom line 0:54 / 1:23 and 66%, with no center readout.
Fresh real X11 swipe capture showed the bottom feedback only and no centered time readout or tall vertical indicator; the settled capture also had none.
After release and a settle window, the semantics reverted to the normal '~' folder crumb and contained no seek target or percentage.
The candidate session contains only one legible during-gesture capture (seek_during.png), so it does not provide the required second during-swipe data point with a different target.
A fresh swipe displayed 0:54 / 3:14 at 28% during the gesture; after release, the paused runtime read was position 54815 ms on the 194255 ms track, within about 1 second of the shown target.
The candidate's event trail records the shotStep=10 mid-gesture screenshot path and output dimensions from its custom frame-yielding drag capture, rather than only a post-release screenshot.
The fresh post-release screenshot showed the bottom crumb restored to '~', with no target/duration/progress text and no center indicator.
The post-settle semantics and tree capture independently showed the normal '~' crumb, agreeing with the settled screenshot.
Real on-screen taps exercised next (index advanced to 4), previous (two-stage previous returned to index 3), and pause/resume; a vertical hero drag left the fixed browser presentation unchanged.
Repeated real X11 swipe attempts and the final runtime capture left the app responsive with overflows count 0 and no runtime error reports.
